description: This is an HTML file that serves as a front-end interface for a Database Viewer application. It provides HTML structure, embedded CSS for styling, and JavaScript for dynamic interaction with a backend API to fetch and display database information, tables, and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and updates the sidebar UI.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a specific database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for the selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a selected table, limiting to 50 records.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data into an HTML table, handling wide content and object display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expansion of cell content for full visibility.
